meet.speaker: Relc
meet.text: Oi. Hold up. Big spear, bored Drake. The official business part is me standing here. You came off the inn hill. Name and errand.

text_variants.text: Dark road, same Drake. Goblins get bold once the sun's down. Keep to the middle where I can see you.
Hah! The inn's errand-runner. Road's been mostly quiet since you passed.
There's the dummy-slayer. Straw fears you. Come here. I owe you something for the show.

Alone. You went into that thing's own hole alone, no backup, and I offered. I've replayed it a dozen ways and every version ends with a body bag. Instead you're standing here being smug at me about it. I don't know whether to buy you a drink or write you up. Reckless conduct is a real charge. I've filed it before.

options.text: Just a traveler. Staying at the inn, heading for Liscor.
You said you had something for me?
Got time to show me how to fight? (Spar)

banter.speaker: Relc
banter.text: Relc. Senior Guardsman, best spear in Liscor. Right now I'm guarding grass. The inn feeds you, the city taxes you. Everything between is my road, so behave on it. There's goblins about. Sing out if you spot one.

options.text: You any good with that spear? (Spar)

warns.speaker: Relc
warns.text: Goblins on the road since the thaw. A warband near the gate with a chief who's got actual teeth. Old stones to the north-east? Stay off them. And the pond is deeper than the gatehouse rope. Stay out of it.

spar_offer.speaker: Relc
spar_offer.text: Ha! Good instinct. Everybody swings wrong at the start, so do your wrong swinging here. Watch keeps training dummies in the gatehouse. I drag a couple out when gate duty gets slow. Don't ask about the wheels. Rules: you move, you hit. If you have to cry, do it before we start.

text_variants.text: Again? Fine. The dummies heal fast. Straw's forgiving that way. Same rules: move, hit, no crying.

gift.speaker: Relc
gift.text: My spare spear. Held gates wider than that one. Now listen. Owning a weapon and holding it are different things. Check your pack, get the spear in your hand before you're back on the road. Sword arm, spear arm. The weapon you carry decides which of your moves come with you.

options.text: I’ll try it on. (Check your pack after this.)

relc_army.speaker: Relc
relc_army.text: Ha! No. Army, before. Liscor's got one. It just never comes home. I did. Walls pay worse. Nobody makes you march in the rain, though. I am done marching. That and the spear are the two best calls I ever made.

relc_army_two.speaker: Relc
relc_army_two.text: Long version costs a drink. Short version: I got tired of holes in the ground and people I liked going into them. Watch work, the worst thing I dig is paperwork. There's a longer version. It costs a drink and I lose the middle of it every time.

relc_after.speaker: Relc
relc_after.text: Miss it? I left people in it. Some I'd still take a spear for, even now. That's all the answer you're getting sober. Hey. You did good down there. Buy me that drink sometime and I'll say the long version.

options.text: I'll hold you to the long version.

relc_wager.speaker: Relc
relc_wager.text: Ugh — fine, you win. Here's your cut. Watch doesn't pay enough for me to keep losing bets to my own students. The paymaster docks me for less.
